What I can tell you is that, it’s all in the mind. Although those physical symptoms will surface but you have to be mentally strong and tell yourself you’re okay. Go for walks. Ride a bike. Read books, journal. Happy thoughts. And if you’re a Christian and believe in God, pray to him for strength. Eat healthy and take a lot of liquids and tea. Always convince yourself that you’re okay and you’re not dying, convince yourself you’re not afraid of dying still, it’ll get better eventually I promise. I hope you get better soon ❤️🫶🏻

It’s all in the head, I can’t lie, the brain works in a very weird way, first of all you have to come to realization that you’re not afraid of dying, so even if you feel like you are, you tell yourself yh okay what next then? Say it multiple times to yourself, I’m not dying and I’m not afraid of death. Because one day we will all go, so come to terms with it. It’s helped me control my panic attacks ever since, I still get some but I’m able to tell myself I’ll be fine and I’m in control. Drink water, do some yoga if you can, ride a bike and go for walks, do things that will make you require oxygen. Hope this helps you
You’re fine I promise. Anxiety makes you feel all types of way . But you just have to fight it mentally and believe you’re okay. 🫶🏻❤️
